Blood-red flames burn all over your body, throwing sparks
Dark purple smoke wraps your body with small flickers of white lightning
Orange flames rise from your hands and feet, scattering ash
White clouds bloom underfoot and rainbow dust rises
Purple spirit energy burns slowly while golden stardust settles
A clear blue-white energy wraps your body, with white and gold sparkles scattering from your crown
Pale pink and sky-blue petals flutter down around you
Blue mist settles as glowing letters slowly rise
Golden flames surge from toe to crown, scattering white embers
The beginning of the world fell from the sky. Stand in the middle of the Meteor Crater
It's warm underfoot. Long ago, a star fell here.

Bring the Stones of the Beginning to the Origin Sage
The Order of Sun and Moon
Touch the four sun pillars in Sundial Plaza in order, from lowest to highest, like the rising sun (T)
On a moonlit night, stand on the island in the middle of Mirror Lake and look at the moon in the water
The moon in the water is brighter than the moon in the sky.
Having seen both sun and moon, return to the Fist Sovereign
Collect the four gears of the stopped clock scattered in the Abandoned Village and Sundial Plaza (T)
Listen beneath the Thousand-Year Bell Tower for how many times the bell rings
The bell rang once. The sound circles the mountain for a long time.
Bring the gears to the Eternal Elder
Defeat five void demons in the Void Rift to close the crack
Stand at the end of the Broken Sky Bridge and look into the void beyond it
It's a long way down. One more step and you fall.
At night, count the stars in the middle of the Star Rock Ring
By the time you finished counting, your fingertips felt cold and clear.
Pick up five star shards fallen in the Nebula Garden of the Heavenly Realm (T)
Bring the star shards to the Starry River Elder
Water the four withered saplings around the Myriad Tree Grove (T)
Defeat three swamp brutes in the Poison Mist Swamp that rot the forest
Find the three fan ornaments dropped below the cherry hill (T)
Return to the Cherry Fan Immortal
Find the four cups of the Dead-Drunk Immortal that rolled off around the wine-jar porch (T)
Bring the cups to the Dead-Drunk Immortal
At night, stand under the blood-red moon of Blood Moon Valley
The moonlight seeps red to the tips of your nails.
Return to the Blood Moon Immortal
Wait for lightning beneath the tallest sword in the middle of the Graveyard of Swords
Blue sparks jump from the sword tip. The hair on your arms stands up.
Return to the Thunder Heaven Immortal
Find the four bone fragments around the whale-bone rock on the west sea shore (T)
Return to the Ancient Whale Immortal
Light the five star lamps of the observatory in order, from the lowest star to the highest (T)
Return to the Star Counting Immortal
Wake the five sleeping stars fallen around the Lotus Pavilion (T)
On a moonlit night, stand on the moon reflected in Mirror Lake
The reflected moon wavers. Drowsiness washes over you all at once.
Light the five lotus lamps on the south shore of the Lotus Pavilion in rainbow order (red → orange → yellow → green → blue, T)
Wake the Dream Sage (talk to him)
Pick up the erased letters dropped at four landmarks (Abandoned Mine entrance · crack in One Sword Rock · behind the Turtle Stele · under the Immortal Pine) (T)
At night, stand in the empty place at the opposite end of the world (the far northwest)
Touch the four blank letter boxes in the order of their names (T)
